title: 第27章 考间冲刺第28章 道术和实战
content_zh:
凌晨三点。
嵩阳高中的办公室内。
苏海峰一边看着电脑屏幕上的列表，一边朝着电话另一头说道“嗯……道心成绩没有什么变化。”
“法力前段时间提升很迅猛，看样子大部分时间和钱应该都用在吐纳上了，这才冲进了前10的水平。”
“**强度虽然因为被孤立的关系，已经三周没测了，但之前就已经跌到了第19名，现在他又把重心放在法力上，能保持19都谢天谢地了。”
“武功、道术也都没什么明显进步，这两门在这次月考跌到30名以后也有可能。”
看着张羽最近的成绩记录，苏海峰摇了摇头“总之，我不太看好他这次月考的成绩会有大幅度进步。”
“学校估计还是会给他丁级合同。”
“我知道了，我会尽量劝说他签下合同的。”
“虽然不知道他是怎么得到李雪莲的赏识，但考试也考了，他应该也认清楚自己的状况了。”
挂了电话，苏海峰随手关闭了张羽的成绩记录，又看起了下一份文件。
对他来说，张羽也不过是众多事情中的一小件罢了，嵩阳高中里有更多的事情，更重要的学生需要他关注。
……
凌晨四点。
烂尾楼里。
今天便是嵩阳高中月考的日子。
虽然经过九日的折磨，张羽的实力再次有了大幅度的进步，但此刻的他还是在抓紧时间进行健体三十六式的练习，争取在考试正式开始之前，再提一提自己的实力。
而他此刻在羽书序章上的面板也变成了
张羽
道心&nbp;1级

法力&nbp;117
**强度&nbp;105级
法力依靠着他的被动吐纳夹杂着不定时的主动吐纳，从105提升到了117。
**强度更是在他的疯狂磨练下，从085级提升到了105级。
当然，这九天里进步最大的还是健体三十六式，此刻已经变成了健体三十六式9级（8990）。
而伴随着张羽此刻最后一拳打出，健体三十六式也终于冲到了10级，提升到了炼气境界所能达到的极限。
也就在他将健体三十六式提升到10级的这一刻，脑海中似有无数记忆流淌而过，那是他一遍又一遍，一遍又一遍练习健体三十六式的身影，是他对自己肉身理解更深刻，更深入的思考。
**在无数次的精心打磨后，终于迎来了某种质变，开始按照一种更合理的方式进行调整。
脑海中似有一道轰鸣声响起！
随着心脏将一**气血泵向他的四肢百骸，张羽的浑身上下仿佛是迎来了一场蜕变。
只见他浑身血肉一阵收缩又膨胀，骨头关节内更是发出一道道咔咔脆响，整个人的身体轮廓隐隐都变大了一些。
筋肉分布变得更加适合发力，骨骼结构变得更加坚固稳定，整个身体似乎也调整得更均衡，更协调。
这本是在将炼体三十六式提升到10级的过程中，一点一点完成的**结构优化，此刻却在瞬间得到完成。
**强度105级→125级
随着身体结构的调整优化，张羽的**强度一口气增长了02级，有了20%的大涨。
特别是张羽能感觉到，这种身体结构优化带来的提升，不仅仅是一次**强度的增长，而是有着更长远的效果，此刻更均衡更协调的**结构，会让他未来的炼体之路走得更好更快。
content_en:
Three o'clock in the morning.
In the office of Songyang High School.
Su Haifeng looked at the list on the computer screen and said to the other end of the phone, "Well... there is no change in Daoxin's results."
"The mana has increased rapidly some time ago. It seems that most of the time and money should be spent on breathing, and then it broke into the top 10 level."
"Although ** strength has not been tested for three weeks due to isolation, it has already dropped to 19th place before. Now he is focusing on mana again. Thank God for being able to maintain 19th."
"There is no significant improvement in martial arts and Taoism. It is possible that these two subjects will fall to 30th place in this monthly exam."
Looking at Zhang Yu's recent performance record, Su Haifeng shook his head, "In short, I'm not very optimistic that his monthly exam results will improve significantly this time."
"The school will probably give him a D-level contract."
"I understand, and I will try my best to persuade him to sign the contract."
"Although I don't know how he got Li Xuelian's appreciation, he passed the exam and he should have understood his situation."
After hanging up the phone, Su Haifeng closed Zhang Yu's score record and looked at the next document.
To him, Zhang Yu is just a small thing among many things. There are more things in Songyang High School, and more important students need his attention.
…
Four o'clock in the morning.
In the unfinished building.
Today is the day of the monthly exam for Songyang High School.
Although after nine days of torture, Zhang Yu's strength has improved significantly again, but at this moment, he is still seizing the time to practice the thirty-six postures of fitness, trying to improve his strength before the official start of the exam.
And his current panel on the prologue of Yushu has also changed to
Zhang Yu
Daoxin&nbp;Level 1
Mana&nbp;117
**Strength&nbp;level 105
Relying on his passive breathing mixed with occasional active breathing, his mana increased from 105 to 117.
The strength of his body was increased from level 085 to level 105 due to his crazy training.
Of course, the biggest improvement in these nine days is the Thirty-six Postures for Healthy Bodybuilding, which has now become Level 9 (8990) of the Thirty-Six Postures for Healthy Bodybuilding.
With Zhang Yu's last punch at this moment, the thirty-six physical fitness exercises finally reached level 10, reaching the limit that can be achieved in the realm of qi refining.
At the moment when he upgraded the Thirty-Six Bodybuilding Postures to level 10, countless memories seemed to flow through his mind. It was him practicing the Thirty-Six Bodybuilding Postures over and over again. It was his deeper understanding and deeper thinking about his physical body.
**After countless careful polishings, it finally ushered in some kind of qualitative change and began to adjust in a more reasonable way.
There seemed to be a roar in my mind!
As his heart pumped a stream of energy and blood to his limbs, Zhang Yu's whole body seemed to be undergoing a transformation.
I saw that the flesh and blood all over his body shrank and expanded, and there were crackling sounds in the bones and joints, and the outline of his entire body became slightly larger.
The distribution of muscles becomes more suitable for exerting force, the bone structure becomes stronger and more stable, and the entire body seems to be more balanced and coordinated.
This optimization of body structure was completed bit by bit in the process of upgrading the Thirty-six Body Refining Exercises to level 10, but now it was completed in an instant.
**Intensity level 105 → level 125
With the adjustment and optimization of the body structure, Zhang Yu's sexual strength increased by 02 levels in one breath, a 20% increase.
In particular, Zhang Yu can feel that the improvement brought about by this optimization of body structure is not just an increase in physical strength, but has a longer-term effect. The more balanced and coordinated physical structure at this moment will make his future body training journey go better and faster.
